eugenia.Name: Poplicher

eugenia.Forced labor: From September 1941 to December 1943 he was send to forced labor in Braila, Barlad and Roman.
eugenia.Other sufferings: On July 1, 1940, during the pogrom in Dorohoi, his bar was distroyed. On December 31, 1940 he was not permited to sell alcohol.
eugenia.Family members who died: His wife, Clara, died on Feb 28, 1942 in Moghilev, because of typhus.

On February 16, 1944, he was sent to the Roads Battalion in Focsani where he was reassigned to camp 5 (?) until August 23, 1944.

eugenia.Name: Poplicher
eugenia.Educational level: Student at the Faculty of Medicine
eugenia.Other sufferings: arested in June 1940 for 8 days at the Dorohoi police accused of communism
eugenia.Family members who died: Hi mother Clara died on November 28, 1942 in Moghilev, hunger

eugenia.Name: Helman
eugenia.Deportation details: When crossing the Dniester, she was robbed by the Romanian Army: 2 suitcases with clothes, a winter coat, an overcoat, 6 dresses, 12 pairs of stockings, 10 shirts, 15 pairs of panties, 2 pairs of shoes, 4 blankets, 4 pillows, a gold watch, 2 gold rings. All the time in Transnistria she endured hunger and cold and misery.
eugenia.Family members who died: Her mother, Helamn Ghitta, starved to death in Moghilev.

eugenia.Name: Goldenberg
eugenia.Other sufferings: Her shop was destroyed in January 1941
eugenia.Family members who died: Her husband, Goldenberg Herscu, died in Sargorod on February 25, 1942.

eugenia.Name: Leizerovici
eugenia.Deportation details: All our belongings were taken by the Romanian gendarmes and they forced us to leave all our luggage at Atachi, to take only what we could carry on our backs. The children were beaten and mistreated and locked up in the legion of Romanian gendarmes on the grounds that they were smuggling to earn a piece of bread so that we wouldn't starve.
eugenia.Family members who died: His father (Hercu Altero), mother-in-law (Risa Leizerovici), brother-in-law (Hersu Lipitora) and niece (Lara Rozentfaig)  died of hunger in Moghilev.

eugenia.Name: Dulce
eugenia.Family members: Malca (wife); Oisie, 1922; Etla 1924; Smoie, 1926; iulia, 1928; Rasela, 1931
eugenia.Other sufferings: On July 1, 1940, when the Dorohoi pogrom took place, they were robbed and threatened with death.

eugenia.Name: Reghinstref
eugenia.Family members who died: Her husband Herman and child Ieli died in Bersad.

dossiers.munca_fortata: nimic de el de la 15 Sept. 1941 până în prezent

eugenia.Name: Argintaru
eugenia.Deportation details: On July 15, 1941, they were taken by the Police for 5 days, then evacuated to Edinet. Their parents froze to death in the Corbu Forest. They arrived in Moghilev in a camp without a roof and windows. The next day they went further, where we strewn the entire road with corpses until they  reached Obodovca. There they  found an abandoned stable where they spent the whole winter.
eugenia.Family members who died: Her father, David Solomon, and mother Ghitla Solomon, died frozen in Corbu Forest. Also her aunt, uncle and cousins - Fruima Herta, Moise Herta died in the forest.  Her siste, Ety Solomon died of hunger in Moghilev.

eugenia.Name: Hularu
eugenia.Deportation details: When crossing the Dniester, they were robbed by Romanian border guards. He worked as a stonecutter, a woodcutter, and a digger. He suffered because of the Romanian soldiers, he suffered from hunger and diseases.
eugenia.Family members who died: Hularu Sura, mother, died of hunger in Moghilev; Helamn Ghtla, mother-in-law, died of hunger in Moghilev.

dossiers.munca_fortata: Detaș 6 drumuri Calfa; cariera de piatră Zvorâște - cazărmi, grajd pădure Roșc.

eugenia.Family members: Ester (1908), wife, Haia (1933), Simcu (1935), Surica (1938), Ghedalie (1942)
eugenia.Family members who died: Ciubotaru Ita, mother-in-law, died of hunger in Moghilev in 1941; Ciubotaru Eli, brother-in-law, died of hunger in Moghilev in 1941

eugeniaRows.Name: Croitoru
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: Deported in October 1941 to Targu Jiu, as comunist. After 3 weeks, his wife and children were deported to Transnitria. He was sent to Lugoj, back to Dorohoi and from there to Transnistria where he was reunited with his family. Tropova
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: His father, Smil Lutfoc, died of hunger in December 1941

eugeniaRows.Name: Cocos
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: He had great losses: his parents, a missing brother. The surviving brother was caught outside the ghetto and beaten by Sergeant Barbulescu.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Hendel Cocos, father, hunger, Moghilev; Clara Cocos, mother, hunger, Moghilev; Mihal Cocos, brother, dissapeared.

eugeniaRows.Name: Bacalu
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: Deported from Moghilev to Peciora with his wife and 19 yo boy, who died there. Upon departure, the Romanian authorities took part of his wealth, and the rest upon crossing the Dniester. He arrived in Moghilev, Tulcin, Scazinet, Peciora. Due to the misery and torture he remained paralyzed. His only child, 19 years old, died in Peciora due to misery and hunger.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Marcu Bacalu, son, died in Peciora.

eugeniaRows.Name: Hularu
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: When crossing the Dniester, they were robbed by Romanian border guards. He worked as a stonecutter, a woodcutter, and a digger. He suffered because of the Romanian soldiers, he suffered from hunger and diseases.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Hularu Sura, mother, died of hunger in Moghilev; Helamn Ghtla, mother-in-law, died of hunger in Moghilev.

eugeniaRows.Name: Herscu
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: He had a house that was distroyed when he was deported.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Kohn Sacharie, father, died of hunger in Moghilev; Kohn Smil, brother, died of hunger in Moghilev

eugeniaRows.Name: Svart
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: He was evacuated to Tg Jiu, from there back to Dorohoi and then  to Transnistria. Then to work for the Germans in Nicolaev.

eugeniaRows.Name: Lax
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: On July 8, 1941, her entire family was drowned in the Prut River, in the town of Nepolcauti, by fascist legionnaires. She alone escaped from the water after a few hours. Out of 38 members of her extended family. She returned to Chernivtsi, lived there until the establishment of the ghetto and was then deported to Transnistria. She still has one surviving son who was taken into the Red Army.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Lax Israel, husband, Lax Lucia, drowned; Lax Leiser, son, died at Edinet of hunger

eugeniaRows.Name: Cuter
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: From Dorohoi was first deported to Tivrev, where one of her daughters died. They were moved to forced labor to Strainet and from there to the Varsilovca ghetto, where her husband died.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Cuter Hoisie, husband, died of hunger in Varsilovca in 1942, Cuter Surica, daughter, died of hunger in Tivriv in 1942

eugeniaRows.Name: Surla
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: She was deported by train to Atachi, from there she went by foot to Sargorod, where she stayed for a year. After that she was sent to a closed ghetto in Cocostarna
eugeniaRows.Forced labor: Her husband was set to Roman, Bucuresti and Dorohoi and then in 1942 to Tulcin where he was shot by the Germans.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Sfartz Strul, shot in Tulcin; Barbieru Lea, mother, died of hunger in Sargorod, Barbieru Moritz, brother, died of hunger in Sargorod.

eugeniaRows.Name: Croitoru
eugeniaRows.Forced labor: From Tg Jiu he was sent to forced labor. Then he was sent to the 8th Division in Chernivtsi, from where he was sent to other cities. Izvoraste, barracks, forest, Detachment 6 Calfa roads, stone quarry
eugeniaRows.Family members: Ester (1908), wife, Haia (1933), Simcu (1935), Surica (1938), Ghedalie (1942)
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Ciubotaru Ita, mother-in-law, died of hunger in Moghilev in 1941; Ciubotaru Eli, brother-in-law, died of hunger in Moghilev in 1941

eugeniaRows.Name: Pincu
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Sura Pincu (daughter-in-law), Bura, Ruchl, Calman, Roza, Haim, Ester (nieces), all died in Pitgrad, of hunger or frozen

eugeniaRows.Name: Golder
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: She was imprisoned in 1941 at the police station in Dorohoi for being a communist. The first impression I had was that I saw a beast in human form called Sergeant Hasanu, the head of the camp who was mercilessly killing the poor people in front of everyone. The next day at dawn we were woken up by shrill screams, warning us to leave further and in 2 minutes to be equipped, who could still get something out of his work and who did not, everything remained in the hands of the criminals.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Golder Buium, husband, died of hunger in Moghilev

eugeniaRows.Name: Ancel
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Fundoianu F, brother; Fundoianu B, sister-in-law

eugeniaRows.Name: Avram
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: When crossing the Dniester I was robbed of my last penny, they took the few things I had left, leaving me in Moghilev completely impoverished. From the first day I was starving to death at the discretion of the first gendarme I met. Then the evacuations from Moghilev to Tulcin.

eugeniaRows.Name: Haimovici
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: Her husband, Haimovici Leib, prisonier in USRR, was edeported to Targu Jiu between June and September 1944.
eugeniaRows.Forced labor: Her husband was sentto forced labor until August 1944.

eugeniaRows.Name: Gott
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Gott Lendra (mother), shot on the way, Freida (sister), Iosub (brother)

eugeniaRows.Name: Ciobotaru
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: I stayed in Tulcin for two and a half months, I was beaten by Romanian gendarmes. When I went back to Varasilofca we went in open wagons the whole time, it rained and snowed on us and they didn't give us food
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Ciubotaru Pesa, wife, died of hunger in Varasilofca; Itcu, son, shot in Tulcin, Avrum, son, beaten to death in Varasilofca, Ghitla, daughter, beaten to death in Varasilofca; Sacagiu Moise, brother, typhus, Sargorod; Sacagiu Froiche, brother, shot in Tulcin; Sacagiu Mirche, sister-in-law, shot in Tulcin; Sacagiu Bruha, sister, Varasilofca, Cohn Sloim, brother-in-law, hunger, Moghilev, Cohn Hana, sister-in-law, hunger, Moghilev; Cohn Altar, nephew, hunger Moghilev

eugeniaRows.Name: Hertanu
eugeniaRows.Forced labor: He did forced labor in Dorohoi in 1942 and 1943

eugeniaRows.Name: Mates
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Sami Mates, brother, shot in Ardeal

eugeniaRows.Name: Segal
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: When we crossed the Dniester, we were robbed, they took everything from me and I was left with only what I had on me and without a penny. I was starving with the child and driven from place to place to camps and many other torments.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Iancu Sigel, son, died in iasi

eugeniaRows.Name: Zissman
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: At the beginning of the war, we were taken out of our house without being able to take the necessary things and sent to Edinet, Bessarabia, the first extermination camp, where we spent 3 months in the darkest misery. After that, I was deported to Transnistria. My husband died of pneumonia from working on the bridge over the Dniester. In the summer of 1942, I was sent to the Scazinet camp with my child, where I lived on grass and leaves, I resisted and was sent back to Moghilev. After 3 months, I was sent to the Matei camp in Peciora, where many died of hunger. I lived, I saw the light, but I remained miserable
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Zissman Leon, husband, illness, Moghilev

eugeniaRows.Name: Rudich
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: Our entire family of 20 people was deported and only 2 of us returned.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Nuham Rudich, father, died in Dorohoi during the evacuation; Hana, mother, died of hunger in Moghilev

eugeniaRows.Name: Gemer
eugeniaRows.Family members: Gemer Rosele, wife, died in Moghilev; Gemer Itcu, father, died in Moghilev; Gemer Sura, sister and Debora, mother, died in Moghilev

eugeniaRows.Name: Cojocaru
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: I am the wife, mother and grandmother of these dead and never once in my life have I wanted to see the bright sun like my dearest ones and my whole life went to Transnistria. When she returned from the camp she fell ill with typhus, was hospitalized and was not deported with the rest of her family.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Cojocaru David, husband, Beh Seculesti, daughetr, Moisala, Grandchild, Cojocaru Ghersem, son, Fani, daughter-in-law, Iosub, Toni, Liba, grandchildren, all died of hunger in Copaigorod in 1942

eugeniaRows.Name: Schnhvalf
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Chaim, husband, died of hunger in Moghilev in 1941

eugeniaRows.Name: Cojocaru
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: His entire family, mother, father, brother and children were shot in the summer of 1941 with 320 people: Men, women children from 1 year old up. Why? For what? For the name of Jew. I escaped like through the eye of a needle, because I was hidden. They were not satisfied with that and they began to persecute us.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Cojocaru Sura, mother, died in Lucinet in 1941, Moise, brother, Lupu, brother, Iosub, child, F Funduianu, father-in-law, died in Febryary 1942 and others

eugeniaRows.Name: Freida
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: From Herta he was marched on foot for 6 days without food and water to Edinet camp. He was beaten by the gendarmes. Edinet ghetto was closed with barbedwire. After two month he was sent to Transnistria.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Lifsa Zalman, mother, died of hunger in Copaigorod in January 1942

eugeniaRows.Name: Rabinovici
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: All our belongings were taken by the Romanian army. What was left of us we sold in Transnistria in the first days to keep ourselves alive. For two months we lived on potato peelings, weeds from the field.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Eva Vitner, mother, died of hunger in Moghilev, Saly vitner, sister-in-law, died of hunger in Moghilev

eugeniaRows.Name: Cohn
eugeniaRows.Forced labor: He did forced labor in Braila

eugeniaRows.Name: Cohn
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: 7 family members died in Transnistria

eugeniaRows.Name: Cohn
eugeniaRows.Forced labor: He was sent to forced labor and his family was deported to Transnistria where they all died.
eugeniaRows.Family members who died: Rudich Marcu, father, Golda, mother,died of hunger in Transnistria, Ziza, sister, died in Dorohoi after returning from Transnistria

eugeniaRows.Name: Groci
eugeniaRows.Deportation details: Ajungand la Nistru cu putinul bagaj pe care l-am salvat din tren, trecand Nistrul jandarmii mi-au luat o parte din lucruri. La Moghilev am fost bagati in lagar intr-o mizerie neagra si peste cateva zile am fost scosi si manati ca niste vite vreo 5 zile pana am ajuns in Sargorod, acolo ne-a bagat mai multe familii la un loc. Neavand ce sa dau de mancare copiilor am mai vandut si restul de lucruri.
